description: Outstanding collateralised SFTR records (collateral_portfolio_code OR collateral_isin set) with no collateral_value reported (or zero, treated as not reported).

Share of SFTR TSR records with haircut outside the regulatory range [0.0, 1.0] (ESMA RTS 2019/356 Art. 4). Counts only records with haircut populated. Rolls up the granular SFTR.COMP.HAIRCUT_OUT_OF_RANGE per-record check.
Share of SFTR TSR records with at least one counterparty LEI missing (reporting_counterparty OR other_counterparty None/empty). SFTR mirror of DQI_LEI_MISSING.
Outstanding SFTR TSR records with no loan_value reported (or zero, treated as not reported). SFTR mirror of DQI_VAL_MISSING.
SFTR TSR records whose state_as_of is older than the configured threshold (TARGET2 business days). Reuses the EMIR TimelinessThresholds.max_valuation_age_business_days config.
SFTR TAR records whose reporting_timestamp lags execution_timestamp by more than the configured max_reporting_delay_hours.

Share of SFTR TSR records where collateral_value × (1 − haircut) is strictly less than loan_value. Counts only records with all 3 inputs populated. Flags either mis-reporting (DQ defect) or genuine under-collateralisation (credit-risk signal).
